title: Reasoning-Trace Analysis Using Large Language Models for Interpretable Q-Matrix Construction
abstract: arXiv:2611.26422v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate Q-matrices for diagnostic classification models that approximate expert specifications, but evaluations have focused on the final matrices, leaving the basis of individual item-attribute assignments unexamined. This opacity limits the responsible use of AI in measurement. We propose Reasoning-Trace Analysis (RTA), a framework in which an LLM generates attribute-labeled reasoning steps through chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting and these steps are analyzed to reconstruct, compare, and inspect each assignment. RTA is intended to supplement expert review and empirical validation. In a simulation study with perturbed fraction subtraction items, four LLMs recovered the required attributes and withheld attributes the items did not require. translated_title: 基于大语言模型推理轨迹分析的可解释Q矩阵构建方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.26422v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）能够为诊断分类模型生成接近专家规范的Q矩阵，但以往的评估仅关注最终生成的矩阵，未考察单个题目-属性分配的依据。这种不透明性限制了人工智能在测量领域的负责任使用。我们提出了推理轨迹分析（RTA）框架：大语言模型通过思维链（CoT）提示生成带有属性标注的推理步骤，然后对这些步骤进行分析，以重构、比较和审查每个题目-属性分配。RTA旨在作为专家审查和实证验证的补充手段。在一项使用扰动分数减法题目的模拟研究中，四个大语言模型成功恢复了题目所需的属性，并且没有为题目分配其不需要的属性。在一项包含11道分数减法题目、536名被试的作答数据、四个大语言模型、最多三种温度设置以及每种条件下100次重复实验的实证研究中，CoT-de（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出推理轨迹分析（RTA）框架，通过分析大语言模型思维链推理中带有属性标注的推理步骤，使Q矩阵构建中每个题目-属性分配的依据变得可解释、可审查，从而弥补以往仅评估最终矩阵而忽视分配基础的不透明性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Reasoning-Trace Analysis (RTA) framework that makes LLM-based Q-matrix construction interpretable and auditable by analyzing attribute-labeled chain-of-thought reasoning steps to reconstruct and inspect the basis of each item-attribute assignment.
